company.name: Roofr
company.shortDescription: Roofr is a roofing software platform that offers measurement reports, digital proposals, invoicing, and payment services.
company.description:
Roofr is a marketplace for roofing and utilizes satellite imagery for instant roofing estimates.

A technologically advanced roofing brokerage that uses revolutionary software to simplify roof replacement and repair. At Roofr, they aim to provide the highest quality workmanship and service in the roofing industry. By providing affordable pricing and revolutionary convenience, Roofr emphasizes the importance of customer experience over company profit.

productsAndServices.description: A roofing business management system for tracking leads, customers, jobs, sales pipelines, tasks, communications, and performance across the project lifecycle.
productsAndServices.name: Roofr CRM

productsAndServices.description: Aerial roof measurement reports that provide roof dimensions, material calculations, structure details, and waste factors for residential and commercial roofing projects.
productsAndServices.name: Roofr Measurement Reports

productsAndServices.description: A proposal builder for creating branded roofing quotes and contracts with pricing options, scope details, customer documents, and electronic signatures.
productsAndServices.name: Roofr Proposals

productsAndServices.description: A lead-generation and qualification tool that gives homeowners immediate roof estimates based on a contractor’s services, pricing, materials, and project options.
productsAndServices.name: Roofr Instant Estimator

productsAndServices.description: Integrated tools for creating, sending, tracking, and settling roofing invoices, including online credit card and ACH/EFT payment processing.
productsAndServices.name: Roofr Payments & Invoicing

productsAndServices.description: A material procurement tool that generates and sends roofing material orders using report quantities, proposal line items, job details, and supplier integrations.
productsAndServices.name: Roofr Material Ordering

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,870,261 to $346,582,270, a 89.55x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 80 (-7 over 90 days) and market heat at 73 (-6).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Kojo, Homebound, iRoofing.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
